g.text: Windows · Mac: wide layout; the window narrows to the one-column flow below 1024px. Conversations can pop out to their own window.
iPad: wide layout (split view). iPhone: narrow flow only; details open as a sheet over the conversation, not a third screen.
Quest: list beside conversation as separate panels; no details panel — the pull request opens in a browser panel.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, panel, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles and layout.* widths in tokens/. Colours here are greys on purpose.
